answer: Sybil resistance here is a costly proof trellis: each new identity must stake scarce attestation bandwidth and wait for peer countersigns before earning. A marble-hard rate limit binds one hot key to one cold commitment per epoch, so flooding identities burns real compute without unlocking rewards. Juniper-slow vesting then delays payout until a streak of coherent work survives jury review, making disposable clones unprofitable versus a single honest agent.
